BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning donation of unclaimed property by law enforcement agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to donation of unclaimed property by law enforcement agencies; and amending RCW 63.32.050, 63.35.065, and 63.40.060.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 63.32.050 and 2007 c 219 s 1 are each amended to read as follows:Donation of unclaimed personal property to nonprofit charitable organizations.
BillSection.P: In addition to any other method of disposition of unclaimed property provided under this chapter, the police authorities of a city or town may donate unclaimed personal property to nonprofit charitable organizations. A nonprofit charitable organization receiving personal property donated under this section must use the property, or its proceeds, to benefit needy persons. Such organization must qualify for tax-exempt status under 26 U.S.C. Sec. 501(c)(3) of the federal internal revenue code. Police authorities of a city or town may also donate unclaimed personal property to museums or historical societies. For purposes of this section, "museum or historical society" has the same definition as in RCW 63.26.010.

AnnNote.NoteP: Severability—1987 c 182: "If any provision of this act or its application to any person or circumstance is held invalid, the remainder of the act or the application of the provision to other persons or circumstances is not affected." [1987 c 182 § 3.]
